items.title: Toxic
items.overview: A powerful drug cartel pulls the strings behind a facade of sun-soaked beaches as a gritty, violent underworld power struggle emerges during the crumbling of Portuguese colonial rule.

items.title: Premada Oorali
items.overview: Premada Oorali is a heartfelt love story set in picturesque villages in the 2020s. The film intertwines romance and family drama, exploring the relationships between a father and son, as well as a boy and girl, as they navigate through intriguing, yet relatable, relationship challenges.

items.title: Kantara - A Legend: Chapter 1
items.overview: While exploring Kantara's mystical forest, Bangra's King Vijayendra dies during the Kadamba reign. Rajashekara seals their realm. Prince Kulashekara massacres to reopen it. Berme, seeking wealth, crosses the divide.

items.title: Inspector Vikram
items.overview: Inspector Vikram is the typical do-gooder cop, who also entertains and ensures no crime is left unsolved. What happens when he gets to meet a villain who is smarter than the average criminal and heads a drug racket?

items.title: K.G.F: Chapter 1
items.overview: A period drama set in the 1970s, KGF follows the story of a fierce rebel who rises against the brutal oppression in Kolar Gold Fields and becomes the symbol of hope to legions of downtrodden people.

items.title: Killer Diary
items.overview: Kavya, an author, writes a weekly series named Killer Diary. However, things take a turn when someone starts murdering people close to her in the same way as depicted in her stories.

items.title: Simple Agi Ondh Love Story
items.overview: Rachana persuades her brother to meet her boyfriend's sister, Ithihasini, hoping that cupid would strike them. However, things take a turn when another girl tricks him into falling in love with her.

items.title: Manavaa 2022
items.overview: In the year 2022, a group of scientists use a serum to resurrect a dead man which succeeds. They are overjoyed, that is until the man breaks free and goes on a murderous rampage.

items.title: KD – The Devil
items.overview: In the early 1970s, a petty criminal Kaali unwittingly involves himself with underworld thugs, catalyzing events beyond his control.

items.title: Sneha Sedu
items.overview: Two vengeful men unknowingly become best friends only to realise that they want to seek revenge on each other. But they are unaware that someone else is responsible for their loss and misery.

items.title: Jarasandha
items.overview: Krishamurthy, a gym trainer, lives with his mother and aspires to win a prestigious title. However, his life changes when he finds himself in the middle of a brutal fight between two warring gangs.

items.title: Dosti
items.overview: Dosti is a romantic family entertainer. In which, the movie revolves around deep friendship between the friends. There is also a triangle love story. Through this movie director tried to address a social issue which is plaguing our Society from many years.

items.title: Yaare Koogadali
items.overview: Kumara and Natesa escape from their village and settle in the city. Later they start to work at a gas station. Soon they are chased by a gang of goons; while their actual truth is revealed.

items.title: Gowdru Hotel
items.overview: A remake of the Malayalam hit 'Ustad Hotel', the film sees an aspiring chef forced to work in a restaurant owned and run by his grandfather, to make ends meet, much against the wishes of his father.

items.title: School Master
items.overview: Jagannath is an admired teacher and a doting father to his daughter, Meghana. His life turns upside down when Meghana is kidnapped by mistake for the release of a gangster, Appu.
